terrain.method: Barycentric interpolation inside original source triangles at 64 m grid nodes; masked by official municipal boundary. No retriangulation, elevation averaging, water fill or extrapolation. Multiple inconsistent hits (>0.01 m) become missing.

limits: Coarse derived display surface, not the original 2.5 m LiDAR resolution or survey-grade heights.
Triangle edges at render boundary conservatively omit any cell containing missing nodes; narrow coastal/island features may disappear at overview resolution.
Citywide means the official municipal boundary, not GTA; all inside-boundary grid nodes have source coverage, not every physical point or structure.
Buildings, land cover, roads and scheduled transit remain the existing district scope; terrain inspection does not upgrade their flat vertical contracts.
Building AVG_HEIGHT is height above its base, not CGVD2013 elevation. Roads, bridges and underground transit cannot blindly follow bare earth.

sources.direction: Source None/Not One-Way permits both directions; 1/Follow-Digitization forward; -1/Against-Digitization reverse. Other pairs excluded.
sources.license_evidence: Official catalogue and CKAN checked 2026-10-31 identify open-government-licence-toronto; older district provenance retains its historical missing metadata.
limits: Cartographic street centrelines projected onto coarse terrain, not road surfaces or correct bridge/tunnel heights. Missing terrain remains missing.
Directed shortest source-length paths are topology experiments, not driving directions or legal/access/turn guidance. No traffic interactions or actor reassignment.
Pending roads, trails, railway, busway, laneways and other classes excluded from this street increment; jurisdiction is not an access guarantee.
Graph excludes inconsistent endpoint IDs and boundary-crossing edges instead of inventing connectivity.
sources.selection: Expressways, ramps, arterials, collectors and local streets intersecting official municipality. Visual lines clipped; graph requires whole single-part edges within boundary, selected City/Province jurisdiction and consistent source intersection endpoints within 0.5 m. No geometric crossing joins, snapping, transfer or inferred connector edges.

grid.sampling: Rasterio/GDAL default polygon pixel-center rasterization, all_touched=false; same-class overlap unioned; multi-class overlap becomes 0/unknown

sources.license_evidence: Official catalogue page and current CKAN license_id identify OGL–Toronto.
limits: Historical classification, not current vegetation or ground truth. Tree canopy can cover roads and other surfaces; classifications describe the top-down view.
Display raster is coarser than source polygons, may lose narrow features; unknown/conflicting cells are transparent, not assumed bare ground.
Flat cartographic overlay with illustrative class colours; no terrain, access, routing or hydrological parameters inferred.
2018 cover, 2025 massing archive and 2026 green-space designations differ in vintage; do not treat disagreements as errors automatically.

normalization.method: GEOS make_valid on invalid individual polygon parts before clipping; accept only valid polygonal results with area difference <=0.01 m²; no buffer/simplification or class reassignment

sources.source_crs: EPSG:2952, verified OpenFileGDB layer metadata, not the older 2008 NAD27 source

derivation.ground: Original PolygonZ TIN clipped in EPSG:2952 and masked by official water polygons; constrained triangulation of clipped polygons retains original TIN barycentric heights, not new terrain interpolation. Triangles below 0.000001 square metres after 0.1 mm rounding are omitted. Ground converted to existing local frame, CGVD2013 metres.
derivation.paving: Union of source-aligned round buffers (illustrative 2.6 m paths / 4 m trails), clipped to municipal water mask and original TIN triangles. Full-width barycentric heights lifted 0.06 m; no surveyed curbs or new access connections.
derivation.paths: Original pedestrian alignments clipped and densified to <=5 m; route sampled every 2 m. Original IDs/directions retained; joins within 0.02 m, no new connectors.
derivation.roads: Source arterial/collector/local/laneway centrelines, not elevated highway or rail. Joined buffers use authored class widths, clipped to original TIN and mapped water; full-width barycentric heights lifted 0.035 m. Not surveyed pavement or structural road elevations.
derivation.crossings: Only CROSSWALK-flagged source paths overlapping illustrative road footprints: remove sidewalk-coloured paving in that overlap, then clip authored 0.6 m paint / 0.6 m gaps (5 mm numerical edge inset) to original TIN, lifted 0.045 m. No signal, access, curb-ramp or surveyed marking claims.
derivation.vegetation: 14 m EPSG:2952 grid samples within valid 2018 canopy polygons, >4 m from route. Reject centres covered by the official water mask, including boundary; hole interiors remain eligible. Stable pre-exclusion candidate IDs retain illustrative styling. Original low-poly shapes, not individual inventory.
derivation.water: Original waterbody polygons clipped; no shoreline simplification. ELEVATION absent; illustrative constant scene level.

limits: Guided virtual walk on source pedestrian alignments; not verified present access, crossing permission or collision simulation.
Original 2023 CGVD2013 bare-earth triangles; no bridge or structural road elevations inferred.
Water footprint follows City topographic mapping; constant 74.5 scene-metre water level is illustrative, not a measured level or datum conversion.
Pedestrian ribbon widths, paving, crossing stripes, facades and tree shapes are original illustration. Trees sample 2018 canopy, not individual inventory locations.
Municipal massing bases remain coarse terrain-relative illustrations; fine ground may intersect them.
